tasks.name: עיגול ל-5 הקרוב
tasks.note: Rounds a price to the nearest multiple of 5 (halves round up), giving 0, 5, 10 or 15.

tasks.name: מחיר כרטיס לפי גיל
tasks.note: Ticket price by age bracket: under 3 free, under 12 costs 5, otherwise 10.

tasks.name: הזמנה דורשת אישור
tasks.note: Flags (15/0) an order whose total quantity times unit price exceeds 20, a product that can reach 225.

tasks.name: דקות איחור
tasks.note: Minutes late: arrival minus start time, floored at 0 when on time or early.

tasks.name: כמה עברו את המבחן
tasks.note: Counts how many of three exam scores reach the pass mark of 10 (0..3).

tasks.name: סוג המשולש
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ if(!a||!b||!c||a+b<=c||a+c<=b||b+c<=a) return 0; if(a===b&&b===c) return 1; if(a===b||b===c||a===c) return 2; return 3; }
tasks.note: Triangle classifier from three side lengths: 0 invalid (needs pair sums up to 30), 1 equilateral, 2 isosceles, 3 scalene.

tasks.name: המוצר הזול ביותר
tasks.note: Cheapest item: the minimum of the list; 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: סכום ביקורת
tasks.note: Checksum: the total of all elements (up to 92) reduced mod 16; 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: הפריט השלישי
tasks.note: Element at fixed index 2 (the third item); 0 when the list is shorter than 3.

tasks.name: מספר עמודים
tasks.note: Pagination: number of pages needed to show the list at 3 items per page (0 for empty).

tasks.name: רווח מקסימלי ממניה
tasks.src: l=>{ let m=0, lo=16; for(const x of l){ if(x-lo>m) m=x-lo; if(x<lo) lo=x; } return m; }
tasks.note: Best buy-then-sell profit: max of l[j]-l[i] over i<j, 0 if prices never rise.

tasks.name: היפוך שלושת הראשונים
tasks.note: Reverses only the first three elements and keeps the rest in place.

tasks.name: מחיקת הפריט השלישי
tasks.note: Deletes the item at index 2 (third position) if it exists.

tasks.name: ביטול ההוספה האחרונה
tasks.note: Undo: drops the most recently added (last) item.

tasks.name: סבב בטורניר
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i+=2) r.push(i+1<l.length?Math.max(l[i],l[i+1]):l[i]); return r; }
tasks.note: Knockout round: the larger of each adjacent pair advances, and an unpaired last element advances automatically.

tasks.name: זוג לכרטיס מתנה 23
tasks.src: l=>{ for(let j=1;j<l.length;j++) for(let i=0;i<j;i++) if(l[i]+l[j]===23) return [l[i],l[j]]; return []; }
tasks.note: Finds the first pair (by position of its second item) whose sum is exactly 23 and returns it in list order; [] if none.
